notes: All configs use the same algorithm and metrics settings so that scene generation parameters remain the main varying factor.
Obstacle overlap is disabled in every config to keep visibility-graph and geometric metrics meaningful.
The set spans compact, medium, large, wide, and tall workspaces together with uniform, central, band-shaped, and corner-biased obstacle layouts.

configs.summary: Compact square scenes with a few small uniformly distributed obstacles and wide free-space corridors.
configs.scene_notes: Mostly open compact layouts; direct paths often break but broad alternate corridors usually remain.
configs.metric_signature: Low obstacle area ratio, high clearance, high largest free component ratio.

configs.summary: Compact square scenes with balanced small-to-medium random clutter and frequent local detours.
configs.scene_notes: Dense local interactions in a compact workspace; straight-line solutions are less frequent.
configs.metric_signature: Moderate obstacle area ratio, reduced clearance, still mostly connected free space.

configs.summary: Compact square scenes with dense uniform clutter where many routes are narrow and highly local.
configs.scene_notes: Tight compact scenes with many short detours and frequent narrow micro-passages.
configs.metric_signature: Higher obstacle area ratio, lower clearance, stronger spread in local cell densities.

configs.summary: Medium square scenes with a few large dominant disks creating macro detours and broad pockets of free space.
configs.scene_notes: Fewer but visually dominant obstacles; path quality depends on choosing the correct side around large disks.
configs.metric_signature: Moderate obstacle area ratio with comparatively larger clearance variance.

configs.summary: Medium square scenes with more large disks and stronger route-deflecting geometry.
configs.scene_notes: Routes are shaped by a smaller number of strong blockers rather than by many tiny collisions.
configs.metric_signature: Higher area ratio than light variant, still moderate cell-density CV compared with clustered families.

configs.summary: Medium square scenes with many large disks, producing long detours and frequent line-of-sight disruption.
configs.scene_notes: Macro-detour scenes where one bad side choice can lengthen the route substantially.
configs.metric_signature: High obstacle area ratio, noticeably lower visibility and lower effective clearance.

configs.summary: Large square scenes with heterogeneous obstacle sizes and long-range routes through mostly open space.
configs.segment: Large-workspace, mixed-scale random obstacles, light density.
configs.scene_notes: Long planning horizons with both tiny and large obstacles; path smoothness starts to matter.
configs.metric_signature: Low-to-moderate area ratio, large component ratio near 1, broad radii CV.

configs.summary: Large square scenes with more heterogeneous obstacles and frequent medium-range rerouting.
configs.segment: Large-workspace, mixed-scale random obstacles, medium density.
configs.scene_notes: Large scenes where obstacle heterogeneity creates both global and local difficulty at once.
configs.metric_signature: Moderate area ratio, high radii CV, moderate cell-density CV.

configs.summary: Large square scenes with dense multi-scale clutter and many competing route structures.
configs.segment: Large-workspace, mixed-scale random obstacles, high density.
configs.scene_notes: Long routes in large workspaces with many choices, dead-ends and detour scales mixed together.
configs.metric_signature: Moderate-to-high area ratio, strong radii CV, visible drop in clearance and connectivity margins.

configs.summary: Square scenes with a soft central concentration that encourages peripheral bypasses.
configs.scene_notes: Central congestion is visible but still porous; many scenes admit both center and edge routes.
configs.metric_signature: Moderate cell-density CV, reduced central clearance, overall connectivity still robust.

configs.summary: Square scenes with a stronger central obstacle cloud and more pronounced ring-like free regions.
configs.scene_notes: A denser core pushes good routes toward the outskirts and amplifies path-length differences.
configs.metric_signature: Higher cell-density CV, lower central clearance, strong boundary-vs-center contrast.

configs.summary: Square scenes with a dense central mass that often creates ring bypasses and selective narrow crossings.
configs.scene_notes: The center becomes the dominant structural feature, often forcing wide arc-like bypasses.
configs.metric_signature: High cell-density CV, low center clearance, reduced straight-line feasibility.

configs.summary: Wide rectangular scenes with a loose vertical clutter belt between left and right free regions.
configs.segment: Wide-workspace cross-barrier scenes, light band density.
configs.scene_notes: Crossing from left to right is usually possible through several openings inside a central belt.
configs.metric_signature: Moderate boundary density, elevated cell-density CV along the x-axis, clearance drops near the center strip.

configs.summary: Wide rectangular scenes with a denser vertical belt that starts to act like a soft barrier.
configs.segment: Wide-workspace cross-barrier scenes, medium band density.
configs.scene_notes: The central strip often leaves a few good crossings whose quality varies strongly from scene to scene.
configs.metric_signature: Higher local density anisotropy, lower central clearance, stronger path-length spread.

configs.summary: Wide rectangular scenes with a dense vertical belt that frequently creates bottleneck-like crossings.
configs.segment: Wide-workspace cross-barrier scenes, high band density.
configs.scene_notes: These are the most barrier-like scenes in the set; a small number of passages may dominate route quality.
configs.metric_signature: Low clearance in the belt, high anisotropy, larger variance in success and runtime across algorithms.

configs.summary: Tall rectangular scenes with one obstacle-rich corner and a long diagonal approach from open space.
configs.segment: Tall-workspace asymmetric clutter, light corner concentration.
configs.scene_notes: One side of the workspace remains fairly open while the destination region is structurally cluttered.
configs.metric_signature: Asymmetric cell-density distribution, moderate area ratio, corridor quality depends on diagonal entry.

configs.summary: Tall rectangular scenes with a stronger corner cluster and more pronounced free-space gradient.
configs.segment: Tall-workspace asymmetric clutter, medium corner concentration.
configs.scene_notes: The target-side cluster grows denser and makes final approach quality much more scene-dependent.
configs.metric_signature: Higher cell-density CV, lower clearance near the clustered corner, larger route asymmetry.

configs.summary: Tall rectangular scenes with a dense corner cluster that can turn the target region into a selective maze.
configs.segment: Tall-workspace asymmetric clutter, high corner concentration.
configs.scene_notes: The diagonal approach remains long and the final region is often the dominant source of difficulty.
configs.metric_signature: Strong asymmetry, reduced clearance near the goal-side cluster, higher runtime variance for detour-sensitive planners.
